definition: A gene whose mutations are causative for neurodevelopmental disorder with progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and brain anomalies (NDMSBA; OMIM #617527), a rare autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental condition.

source.title: Genetic alterations in atypical cerebral palsy identified through chromosomal microarray and exome sequencing
